generatedBy: Set 135 Session 1 -- What the cost record actually says

method.attribution: conversation id only; no clock window is used (seat-cost.md 5.3)
method.claimedSide: every committed version of every docs/session-sets/*/disposition.json, attributed to the session that was in flight at that commit. Auditing only the SURVIVING version reports repairs and hides assertions.
method.driftCaveat: the store is live; every figure here is exact only for a conversation that has ended, and was read at readAt.

classificationTests.asserted_false: ANY committed version declares orchestrator_seat non-contributing while that session's own seatSessionIds were already on record at that commit and the same ids price > 0 today; or declares routed_seat not_applicable (a positive claim that the component cannot exist) while it prices > 0 today.
classificationTests.fabricated_status: a version records a status seat_cost cannot emit for that component (routed_api: measured), or a component outside seat_cost.COMPONENTS.
classificationTests.overclaimed_exact: claimed status 'measured' and the same ids price higher today
classificationTests.honest_floor_drift: claimed 'lower_bound' and the same ids price higher today
classificationTests.recoverable: a CLOSED session made no claim for a component that prices > 0 today; nothing false was said and the number is recoverable by measurement. Closed only -- a session that has not reached its close has not skipped anything.
classificationTests.open_no_block_owed: the session is still in flight (sessionStatus != 'complete') and has a measurement, so it is priceable but owes no disposition.cost block yet. Kept separate from 'recoverable' so an in-flight session is never counted as a historical omission (round-1 finding).
classificationTests.honestly_unmeasurable: no measurement source exists today either

scope.rule: the spec says 'walk the schema-v4 sets'. Every headline figure is computed over schema-v4 sessions that actually ran (status complete or in-progress). Schema-v3 rows and never-started sessions have no cost history to audit.

totals.committedRoutedApiNote: activity-log.json routedApiCalls, sets 001-110, spans BOTH scopes -- it is the only durable per-session cost record this repo has and predates schema v4.

unrecoverable.repoScopedCaveat: scoped by the store's OWN recorded repository field, not by clock. It counts every Copilot CLI conversation opened in this repository, including ad-hoc use that was never a workflow session; nothing in the record distinguishes them. That indistinguishability is the finding: attribution exists only where a sanctioned writer recorded an id.
